zh: Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6（TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing）；Ω_r 由 T_CMB = 2.7255 K 和三代中微子算出
en: Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6 (TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing); Ω_r computed from T_CMB = 2.7255 K and three neutrino species

zh: 平坦、68% 暗能量、32% 物质、一点点辐射。138 亿年前热大爆炸，现在正在加速膨胀，未来永远膨胀。
en: Flat, 68% dark energy, 32% matter, a trace of radiation. A hot big bang 13.8 billion years ago, accelerating now, expanding forever.

zh: 1932 年爱因斯坦和德西特联名提议的"最简单宇宙"：没有曲率、没有 Λ。a ∝ t^{2/3}，减速膨胀到永远。它比我们的宇宙年轻（2/(3H0)）——这个"年龄太小"曾经是它的大麻烦。
en: The "simplest universe" Einstein and de Sitter proposed together in 1932: no curvature, no Λ. a ∝ t^{2/3}, decelerating forever. It is younger than our universe (2/(3H0)) — that "too young" age was once its great embarrassment.

zh: 物质是临界密度的三倍
en: matter at three times the critical density

zh: 物质太多，空间闭合成一个三维球面。膨胀到 1.5 倍后回转，最后压回奇点。星系来得及形成，恒星也来得及燃烧，然后一切被压碎。
en: Too much matter: space closes up into a three-sphere. It expands to 1.5 times its present size, turns around and is crushed back into a singularity. Galaxies have time to form and stars to burn; then everything is crushed.

zh: 空无一物、只有宇宙学常数。a = e^{Ht}，没有奇点、没有热的开端，也永远不会有星系。暴胀期的宇宙近似就是它。
en: Nothing but a cosmological constant. a = e^{Ht}: no singularity, no hot beginning, and never any galaxies. The inflating universe is approximately this.

zh: 什么都没有，只有曲率 Ω_k = 1。a = H0 t 匀速膨胀。其实它只是闵可夫斯基时空换了一套坐标：没有引力，也就没有结构。
en: Nothing at all, only curvature Ω_k = 1. a = H0 t, coasting at constant speed. It is really just Minkowski spacetime in different coordinates: no gravity, hence no structure.

zh: w < −1 的暗能量密度随膨胀反而增大。哈勃常数越来越大，有限时间内 a → ∞：先撕开星系团，再撕开星系、太阳系、原子（Caldwell 2003）。
en: With w < −1 the dark-energy density grows as the universe expands. The Hubble constant keeps rising and a → ∞ in finite time: first galaxy clusters are torn apart, then galaxies, the solar system, atoms (Caldwell 2003).

zh: 封闭，Λ 刚好比爱因斯坦静态宇宙需要的多一点。大爆炸之后在 a ≈ 0.6 附近徘徊了两百多亿年（从大爆炸后 70 亿年到 300 亿年几乎静止），然后被 Λ 推走。爱因斯坦的静态宇宙就是它徘徊得无限久的极限——而且不稳定。
en: Closed, with Λ just a little more than Einstein's static universe needs. After the big bang it loiters near a ≈ 0.6 for more than twenty billion years (almost static from 7 to 30 billion years after the bang), then Λ pushes it away. Einstein's static universe is the limit in which it loiters forever — and it is unstable.

zh: 封闭、Λ 很大：往回追溯，收缩到最小 a ≈ 0.65 后反弹。从未热过，没有氦也没有 CMB——1960 年代一度流行，被类星体计数和 CMB 否决。
en: Closed, with a large Λ: traced backwards it contracts to a minimum a ≈ 0.65 and bounces. It was never hot — no helium, no CMB. Briefly popular in the 1960s, ruled out by quasar counts and the CMB.

zh: 负的宇宙学常数像一根越拉越紧的弹簧：即使空间是开放的也会回转坍缩。弦论里最自然的真空就是 AdS，这是它作为宇宙的样子。
en: A negative cosmological constant acts like a spring that pulls harder the more it is stretched: even open space turns around and collapses. The most natural vacuum in string theory is AdS; this is what it looks like as a universe.

zh: 辐射主导到今天：a ∝ t^{1/2}。辐射压让物质扰动几乎不长（Mészáros 效应），永远是一锅均匀的热汤。
en: Radiation-dominated to this day: a ∝ t^{1/2}. Radiation pressure keeps matter perturbations from growing (the Mészáros effect) — forever a uniform hot soup.

zh: Λ 太大，星系永不形成
en: Λ too large: galaxies never form

zh: 暗能量占比是我们宇宙的 ~230 倍（Ω_Λ/Ω_m ≈ 500 而不是 2.2）。它在 a ≈ 0.13 就接管膨胀，扰动增长被冻结，连最高的密度峰也凑不成一个星系。温伯格 1987 年据此论证：若 Λ 真的是随机的，观察者只会在 Λ 不太大的宇宙里醒来。
en: The dark-energy share is ~230 times ours (Ω_Λ/Ω_m ≈ 500 instead of 2.2). It takes over the expansion at a ≈ 0.13, the growth of perturbations freezes, and even the highest density peaks never gather into a galaxy. Weinberg argued from this in 1987: if Λ is really random, observers only ever wake up in universes where it is not too large.
